top_findings.title: GET /books/{id} always returns 404, even for existing books
top_findings.evidence: book_service.c:34 — books_json() consumes all rows leaving the statement at SQLITE_DONE, after which sqlite3_data_count() returns 0 (verified: row stepped=1, data_count=0), so `found` is always 0 and the handler returns 404 for every id.
top_findings.suggestion: Detect whether a row was emitted before the statement runs to completion, and branch on that instead of calling sqlite3_data_count() after SQLITE_DONE.
